prompt:
The charts below show the main reason given for moving home by two age groups in one region in 2023.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Main reason given for moving home by two age groups, 2023
categories: A new job or course of study
visual.alt: Two pie charts showing the percentage breakdown of reasons for moving home, shown separately for movers under 35 and movers aged 35 and over; each pie totals 100.

key_points: The top reason is completely different for the two groups: a new job or course of study leads for movers under 35 (34%), while living nearer family leads for those 35 and over (42%)
The biggest gap is in the family reason: 13% versus 42%, more than three times as much; the second-largest gap is in job/study (34% versus 11%)
Lower housing costs rank second or close to second in both groups and are the category with the closest shares (27% versus 22%)
Wanting a larger home holds a similar, mid-sized share in both groups (18% versus 12%)
In the younger group, reasons cluster around job and cost (61% combined), while in the older group a single reason (family) dominates
Other reasons form the smallest or near-smallest slice in both pies (8% and 13%); each pie totals 100%
common_mistakes: Describing the share as if it were a number of people ('34 people moved for work') — the charts give percentages
Describing the two pies one after another without comparing the two groups
Stopping at the two largest slices and never mentioning the smaller ones
Inventing reasons or giving recommendations ('older people should stay near their families')
Overlooking that the two pies show two separate age groups, not the same people
